### MEDIUM: Opt\-in resident RAM prefix cache contradicts T\-041's "no production RAM tier" assumption and does not say how it is scoped
[changelog\.d/nemotron\-super\-media\-discovery\.md:57](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/6e2e46a38ab27c0e9c0450b5320f58ccbb3988dd/changelog.d/nemotron-super-media-discovery.md#L57) · A-001, ADV-002, T-041

The changelog adds DARKBLOOM\_PREFIX\_CACHE\_MEMORY=1\. It opts the Super owner into a resident, RAM\-based recurrent checkpoint bank \(min\(1 GiB, grant/8\)\) that is reserved from load to retirement and reused across requests\. T\-041 and its mitigations assume the SSD tier is the sole production cache and that production never constructs or funds a resident\-RAM prefix cache\. hardware\-support\.md still says "ramPrefix is always 0 in production"\. The changelog does not say that reuse is bound to the coordinator\-authored cacheSalt \(account, model build, prompt contract\)\. It also does not say whether the RAM bank honours the DARKBLOOM\_PREFIX\_CACHE=0 kill switch, which the changelog does not mention\. If the bank is not salt\-scoped, a malicious consumer could confirm another tenant's prefix through a TTFT hit/miss oracle, or restored state could cross account boundaries\. This would be a regression beyond the accepted same\-account SEC\-035 risk\. Fix: update T\-041 and the mitigations to cover this tier\. State that the bank folds cacheSalt into its lookup key, honours the kill switch, and has no cross\-account reuse\. Keep the flag off for multi\-tenant serving until that is verified\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### LOW: New native image\-decoding surface for consumer\-supplied media is not covered by the threat model
[changelog\.d/nemotron\-super\-media\-discovery\.md:12](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/6e2e46a38ab27c0e9c0450b5320f58ccbb3988dd/changelog.d/nemotron-super-media-discovery.md#L12) · ADV-002, T-010, T-029, TB-007

The opt\-in Super owner hook decodes untrusted, consumer\-supplied inline PNG/JPEG on the provider with a CPU decoder and ImageIO\. It also applies EXIF/XMP orientation and runs a tower and projector pass sized to the largest image\. The changelog says geometry is bounded before allocation, but this is a new parser and memory\-exhaustion surface \(decompression bombs, malformed metadata\) inside the process that holds decrypted prompts and the X25519 key\. TB\-007, T\-010 and T\-029 do not cover it\. The feature is unregistered and default\-off, which limits current exposure\. Fix: document the parser bounds \(pixel count, metadata size, decode time\) and add the surface to TB\-007\. Add fuzz or negative tests before the hook is enabled or registered\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### LOW: Docs add a resident\-RAM, unscoped prefix\-cache path that contradicts T\-041's "no production RAM tier" posture
[docs/architecture/inference\.md:131](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/6e2e46a38ab27c0e9c0450b5320f58ccbb3988dd/docs/architecture/inference.md#L131) · A-001, T-041, TB-007

The new inference\.md text describes \`NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache\`\. When \`DARKBLOOM\_PREFIX\_CACHE\_MEMORY=1\`, it gives the owner a resident recurrent checkpoint bank carved from the KV grant\. Text requests are then submitted with prefix caching on and "the local unscoped cache scope"\. T\-041 and its mitigations state that production never constructs or funds a resident\-RAM prefix cache\. They also state that the only tier is the encrypted SSD tier, with a coordinator\-authored per\-account cacheSalt and a 30\-minute TTL, and that SEC\-035 sign\-off is required for changes to the cache\. The new bank has no per\-account scope, no encryption and no TTL\. If the Nemotron Super owner is ever registered or wired into ProviderLoop, concurrent consumers would share prefix state across tenants, with the TTFT oracle \(leak \#1\) and no account isolation\. The docs say the builder is unregistered and that no production caller installs the HTTP hook, so there is no live regression today\. The threat model should record this path and gate it explicitly: either require a coordinator\-supplied cacheSalt before registration, or extend T\-041's affected files and detection\_hint to cover \`NemotronSuperLocalPrefixCache\` and the unscoped scope\. The docs should also state that the env var is local/dev\-only\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5
